items.claim: CFO 說 FY27 全年財測已上調
items.quote: we basically increased the guidance for fiscal year '27
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說下半年財測也比 90 天前高
items.quote: the guidance for the second half also is higher
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 拆解上下半年營收中點約五五對分（Q1 含多一週）
items.quote: roughly the revenue is split almost 50-50
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問財測高低端風險，CFO 表示等本季結束再更新
items.quote: we'll wait until the end of this quarter
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說營運利益率財測中點上調約 120 個基點
items.quote: increased the operating margin guidance at the midpoint
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說分銷通路沒有塞貨的動態
items.quote: there is no stocking the channel for this type of dynamics
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 Q1 需求跨區域、客戶類型與產業皆成長
items.quote: we experienced broad-based demand
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問供給，CFO 表示對交付財測的供給有把握（部分 LTA、部分承諾）
items.quote: we feel comfortable about the supply we have
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說漲價因素屬通膨環境下正常現象，並把成長歸因於 AI 與基礎設施現代化
items.quote: pretty normal and understandable and inflationary environment
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 Q2–Q4 產品毛利率預期比 90 天前略好
items.quote: slightly better product gross margin than we had expected
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說全年毛利率財測略低，原因是產品營收占比較高
items.quote: that's solely driven by the richer product revenue mix
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問零組件通膨何時緩和，CFO 說現在下判斷太早
items.quote: too early to sort of make a call on the component pricing
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說零組件成本漲價已轉嫁數季
items.quote: pass through the component cost inflation
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說全快閃與混合快閃的毛利差異不大
items.quote: we don't have much of a differential on the margin side
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: IR 提醒不要假設歷來各產品類別的相對毛利在現況下仍成立
items.quote: I wouldn't necessarily assume that the historical
items.speaker: VP IR

items.claim: CFO 說 AI 案件平均規模變大，從概念驗證走向量產部署
items.quote: the average size of the deal is now bigger than before
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 Q1 全快閃陣列營收年增 47%
items.quote: the all-flash array business grew by 47%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說混合快閃營收連兩季小幅年增，前面是多季下滑
items.quote: a small uptick in the hybrid flash revenue year-on-year
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 CPU 伺服器部署後需要儲存，但規模現在難判斷
items.quote: It's a bit too early to tell the magnitude
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問 AI 占營收比重，CFO 說未來 AI 與非 AI 界線會模糊
items.quote: the line between AI and non-AI could become blurry
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問儲存 TAM 未來兩三年規模，CFO 說現在判斷太早
items.quote: it is too early for us to tell where this could be
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問 AFX 與 Vast／WEKA 等的差異，CFO 說有客戶處於 AFX 認證階段
items.quote: some customers that are in certification phase on AFX
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 稱統一平台是差異化關鍵
items.quote: which is really the key differentiator for us
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說公有雲 Q1 剔除多出一週後約成長 19%
items.quote: for the extra week that we had in Q1, it was around 19%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說公有雲高個位數以上（high-teens）成長率可持續
items.quote: the high teens growth rates are sustainable
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說對公有雲內 AI 工作負載的能見度有限，因為是客戶的客戶
items.quote: the visibility isn't as great
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說公有雲長期毛利率區間為 80–85%
items.quote: The long-term range for us is 80% to 85%
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說公有雲毛利率區間暫不調整，但承認有上行偏向
items.quote: We think there's potentially some upward bias
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 Keystone 對整體毛利與營業利益率有正貢獻
items.quote: It's accretive to our overall gross margin
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說費用成長不超過營收成長的一半，並稱 FY27 財測仍在此框架內
items.quote: not to have OpEx grow faster than half of the growth rate
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說資本配置不變，最高將 100% 自由現金流還給股東
items.quote: return up to 100% of our free cash flow to our shareholders
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說 DataPelago 與 JetStream 是小型技術補強併購
items.quote: both of these are small tuck-ins
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 被問客戶如何調整預算，CFO 說客戶依業務優先順序編預算
items.quote: customers budget based on their business priorities
items.speaker: CFO

qa_flags.question: 漲價（P×Q）在財測中占多少、持續漲價是否為財測上行空間
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給任何數字，改談 AI 採用與基礎設施現代化是成長的底層驅動

qa_flags.question: 除供給外還有哪些上行因素，以及財測低端的風險
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未回答上行因素或低端風險，只說財測已納入當時所有資訊、等本季結束再更新

qa_flags.question: 快閃占比上升對產品毛利率的影響
qa_flags.response_pattern: 確認 Q1 快閃占比較高，但前瞻不拆分；IR 補充不要假設歷來各產品毛利關係仍成立

qa_flags.question: AI 案件未來兩三年可占營收多少
qa_flags.response_pattern: 不給比例，改說 AI 與非 AI 界線會變模糊
